# Quill

The Plotworx editor core: document model, layout, rendering, input handling and file formats in pure Rust. It began as a fork of [WordCraft](https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft) and is now its own component; it can still import upstream changes.

- What Quill is and how it relates to upstream: [QUILL.md](../QUILL.md)
- Change and import log, validation results, import procedure: [PATCHES.md](../PATCHES.md)
- Licence: `MIT OR Apache-2.0` ([MIT](../LICENSE-MIT), [Apache-2.0](../LICENSE-APACHE)); upstream notices in [NOTICE](../NOTICE) and [ATTRIBUTION.md](../ATTRIBUTION.md)
- Upstream's own README (about WordCraft, kept unchanged so imports stay clean): [README.md](../README.md)

Consumers (Plotworx Runtime and Desk) depend on the `plotworx` branch.
